purpose: Fill the missing deterministic v1.5 cells against already completed original-Krikri outputs before funding broader peer reruns.
preflight_gates: Resolve the exact snapshot directory; reject main, branch names and any other hash.
Record SHA-256 of config.json, tokenizer_config.json, chat_template.jinja, generation_config.json and model index before serving.
Run 8 deterministic items per benchmark-language cell and all local scorer preflights; require zero request errors, stable IDs and nonempty outputs.
Do not copy any benchmark item into training or data-repair inputs.
local_scoring_in_allocation: IFBench strict/loose with core/extension and family tables
held_out_of_first_allocation: LLM judging for XSTest and MultiChallenge
comparison_rule: Reuse the original-Krikri artifacts only after verifying their benchmark hashes and generation contract match this run. Otherwise rerun the original in the same allocation before comparison.
